title: Reversible experiment and task decomposition playbook
baseline: record the current state: tool versions, media identifiers, hashes, and settings
hash every input before touching it and store the manifest beside the evidence
capture the hardware model, firmware version, reader firmware and cable path
record the operator authorization for the material in scope
stop_conditions: a read is not repeatable across two independent passes
the media becomes warmer than usual, emits noise, or the reader reports unstable current
any step would require circumvention, leaked tooling, or unlicensed firmware
evidence hashes stop matching the recorded baseline
the overall time budget or file-count budget is exceeded
rollback: restore the pre-change snapshot or copy, then re-hash and compare against the baseline
keep changes in a copy-on-write directory so the original media is never modified
reverse the step from the recorded command log; never delete evidence during rollback
mark the run as rolled back and attach both baselines to the report
approvals: writing to firmware, flash, EEPROM or optical media
publishing or sharing any report that names a person, account or device
deleting evidence through the retention controller

stages.objective: Establish lawful ownership and bring the material into a controlled workspace.
checklist: record the ownership/authorization statement with: gate authorize --attest
log the material reference, region and visible serial or label text
copy media into a workspace directory that is separate from the originals
confirm the destination has enough free space for at least two full copies
stages.exit_criteria: an authorization record exists and covers every material in scope

stages.objective: Create a verified baseline without modifying the source.
checklist: hash every file into a manifest before any conversion
perform at least two independent reads of physical media
compare the reads and stop on any divergence
store the manifest and the raw read log next to the evidence
stages.exit_criteria: two reads agree and the manifest hash is recorded

stages.objective: Determine what the material actually is.
checklist: inspect container headers, magic values and size relationships
match against a trusted DAT if one is available and versioned
record platform, region, revision and any uncertainty explicitly
stages.exit_criteria: format, platform and confidence are recorded

stages.objective: Read structures without extracting or decrypting anything.
checklist: list the structures the format documents publicly
note any field you cannot verify and why
keep proprietary or NDA-bound structure notes out of shareable reports
stages.exit_criteria: structure notes exist and are marked with their evidence source

stages.objective: Reproduce the observation with an independent tool or worker.
checklist: repeat the identification on a clean worker or fresh snapshot
record tool versions and settings for both runs
treat disagreements as findings, not as noise
stages.exit_criteria: a second independent run agrees or the difference is explained

stages.objective: Exercise the behavior that matters for the claimed result.
checklist: define pass/fail criteria before running
capture logs, frames or traces that support the verdict
record emulator or hardware version, firmware and controller configuration
compare hashes first, then behavior, then performance
separate exact duplicates, overdumps and revisions
record discrepancies with environment details
stages.exit_criteria: differences are listed with their cause or marked unknown

checklist: run the guardrail scan in package mode and resolve every blocking finding
keep the package metadata-only unless rights are explicitly established
exclude nested archives, keys, firmware and content you may not share
stages.exit_criteria: scan verdict is clear and the report states the rights basis

stages.objective: Hand the work to another operator without losing context.
checklist: render one report with the report command
append the provenance records to the hash-chained ledger
list open issues, rollback steps and the exact tool versions used
stages.tool_hint: tools-console-agent.py report / provenance append / provenance verify-ledger
stages.exit_criteria: report plus verified ledger reproduces the whole run

cartridge.notes: Cartridge work: clean contacts dry, verify voltage, prefer two readers if available.
extra_preserve: record the board revision, chip markings and mapper/board type
read the save memory before any write-capable operation

game-boy.notes: Game Boy work: confirm MBC type and battery state before reading saves.
extra_identify: verify the Nintendo logo and both header checksums

nes.notes: NES work: distinguish iNES from NES 2.0 headers and confirm mapper/submapper.
extra_identify: record mapper, submapper, mirroring and PRG/CHR banking

snes.notes: SNES work: header offset depends on the mapping mode; check both LoROM and HiROM.
extra_identify: confirm checksum/complement consistency and the mapping byte

optical.notes: Optical work: record the drive model, firmware and read offsets; use ddrescue for damage.
extra_preserve: record drive model, firmware, read speed and error map
verify the image against a redump-style DAT when one is versioned locally

arcade.notes: Arcade work: document the board, JAMMA wiring and any suicide-battery state first.
extra_acquire: photograph the board and record the harness pinout before power-on

ps4.notes: PS4 work requires PlayStation Partners access, a licensed SDK and a devkit.

ps5.notes: PS5/PS5 Pro work requires PlayStation Partners access, a licensed SDK and a devkit.

xbox.notes: Xbox One and Series work requires Microsoft GDK access and licensed hardware.

switch.notes: Switch and Switch 2 work requires Nintendo Developer Portal access and licensed hardware.

fpga.notes: FPGA work: lint and simulate before synthesis; keep pin constraints under version control.
extra_test: run lint, simulation and timing analysis before any hardware flash
